interface.shortDescription: Build agent-ready MCP connectors for any API or DB
interface.longDescription: Elliot turns existing products into agentic products. Use it to design verb-first tool contracts, size results for context windows, validate connectors with deterministic evals, deploy them to a runtime, and observe every agent session. Ships 8 workflow skills plus the Elliot MCP server.
